[[Snake]] asks you to retrieve the {{PAGENAME}} from the [[Dungeon]] on level 15. It can be bought alternatively from the [[Witch]] for {{Money|100000}}. It can also be gained as a quest reward from both the [[Woodcutter]] and [[Master Alaric]] (requires the [[Game of Crone]] DLC).
